t: The Unibond No More Nails 3-in-1 is a high-performance hybrid sealant, adhesive, and filler designed for both interior and exterior applications. This versatile clear polymer formula bonds, seals, and fills gaps up to 35mm. It is ideal for trade professionals installing bathroom fixtures, skirting boards, and outdoor guttering. The solvent-free, low-odour formula provides a flexible, waterproof, and mould-resistant finish. It adheres to tough materials like brass, copper, and natural stone, and can be painted over once fully cured to ensure a clean, professional result.
b: Paintable with Most Non-Alkyd Resin-Based Paints
Apply in Wet or Dry Conditions
Resists Mould & Water for Clean Joints
Fits Standard Cartridge Guns for Easy Dispensing
